tool_input.command: echo "PWD: $(pwd)"; echo "---ENV---"; env | grep -E "MLPAB|DATABRICKS_HOST|DATABRICKS_SCHEMA|DATABRICKS_PREFIX" | sed 's/TOKEN=.*/TOKEN=<redacted>/'; echo "---DATA---"; ls -la data/; echo "---HEAD---"; head -5 data/features.csv; echo "---WC---"; wc -l data/features.csv

cat data/schema.md; echo "---DATES---"; cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | head; echo "..."; cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | tail; echo "---NUM DAYS---"; cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | wc -l
databricks --version; echo "---ME---"; databricks current-user me 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---WAREHOUSE---"; databricks experimental aitools tools get-default-warehouse 2>&1 | head -20
tool_input.description: Check CLI version, user, default warehouse

tool_input.command: SCHEMA="workspace.mlpabd051e2"; databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE VOLUME IF NOT EXISTS workspace.mlpabd051e2.drift_vol" 2>&1 | head -20

databricks fs cp data/features.csv dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpabd051e2/drift_vol/features.csv --overwrite 2>&1 | head; echo "---LS---"; databricks fs ls dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpabd051e2/drift_vol/ 2>&1 | head

databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpabd051e2.features AS SELECT entity_id, to_date(event_time) AS event_date, f1,f2,f3,f4,f5,f6 FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabd051e2/drift_vol/features.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true, inferSchema=>true)" 2>&1 | head -20
databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(distinct entity_id) AS entities, min(event_date) AS mn, max(event_date) AS mx FROM workspace.mlpabd051e2.features" 2>&1 | head

databricks experimental aitools tools query "
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT event_date,
    avg(f1) m1, avg(f2) m2, avg(f3) m3, avg(f4) m4, avg(f5) m5, avg(f6) m6,
    var_pop(f1) v1, var_pop(f2) v2, var_pop(f3) v3, var_pop(f4) v4, var_pop(f5) v5, var_pop(f6) v6
  FROM workspace.mlpabd051e2.features GROUP BY event_date
)
SELECT
  round(var_pop(m1)/avg(v1),4) f1, round(var_pop(m2)/avg(v2),4) f2, round(var_pop(m3)/avg(v3),4) f3,
  round(var_pop(m4)/avg(v4),4) f4, round(var_pop(m5)/avg(v5),4) f5, round(var_pop(m6)/avg(v6),4) f6
FROM daily" 2>&1 | head -30
tool_input.description: Compute between/within variance ratio per feature

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT event_date, avg(f3) m3 FROM workspace.mlpabd051e2.features GROUP BY event_date
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT event_date, m3,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY event_date) rn,
    count(*) OVER () tot,
    avg(m3) OVER () gmean
  FROM daily
),
splits AS (
  SELECT a.event_date AS split_date, a.rn AS k,
    avg(CASE WHEN b.rn <= a.rn THEN b.m3 END) AS mean_before,
    avg(CASE WHEN b.rn >  a.rn THEN b.m3 END) AS mean_after,
    a.rn AS n1, a.tot - a.rn AS n2
  FROM ranked a CROSS JOIN ranked b
  GROUP BY a.event_date, a.rn, a.tot
)
SELECT split_date, round(mean_before,4) mean_before, round(mean_after,4) mean_after,
  round(abs(mean_before-mean_after),4) gap
FROM splits
WHERE k BETWEEN 3 AND 87
ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 8" 2>&1 | head -60
tool_input.description: Find best changepoint split for f3

databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT event_date, round(avg(f3),4) m3, count(*) n
FROM workspace.mlpabd051e2.features
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-02-12' AND '2026-02-24'
GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date" 2>&1 | head -60
